interface.resolver: resolveShopifyAdminToken(env, { domain, fetchImpl = globalThis.fetch, now = Date.now }) -> Promise<string>

behavior: Validates an exact lowercase one-label myshopify.com domain before a same-shop POST form exchange, with redirect:error and credentials:omit.
Requires HTTP200 JSON with exactly access_token/scope/expires_in; rejects malformed bodies, token/control characters, extra keys, redirects, mismatched response URLs and non-allowlisted scopes.
Caches tokens only in memory by hashed domain/client-ID/secret identity. A transient credential identity joins concurrent calls before asynchronous hashing and is removed on settlement.
Uses request-start-based expiry with a60-second safety margin, validates clocks and lifetime, isolates rotation and old-request completion, and aborts timed-out requests.
Returns only the token; emits no logs, credential-bearing URLs, upstream error text, error body or cause. No persistence, retry or legacy fallback.

scopeAssessment.productData: read_products covers the Product/ProductVariant resource family used by counts, media, prices and product-owned metafields.
scopeAssessment.metadata: read_metaobjects is justified by taxonomy metafield references reading Metaobject.displayName. The collector does not query definitions, so read_metaobject_definitions is not allowed.
scopeAssessment.minimum: Any nonempty returned subset is accepted only for permission safety; auth does not certify that the subset suffices for all collector queries. Full live limited-token collection is a separate gate.
scopeAssessment.excluded: All write, customer, order, theme, billing and other unrelated read scopes are rejected.

officialSources.finding: Current guide requires an installed Dev Dashboard app in the same Shopify organization as the store; token scope reflects installed app-version permissions, not request-time narrowing. Documented expiry is86399 seconds.
Current read-scope resource mappings support products, markets, locales, translations and metaobjects.
Current2026-07 query reference explicitly requires read_publications, which the general table omits.
